caseNameFull: Williams v. Fanning, Postmaster of the City of Los Angeles
attorneys: Irving M. Walker for petitioners. Acting Solicitor General Washington, Assistant Attorney General Sonnett, Paul A. Sweeney and Melvin Richter for respondent.

opinions.text: The petition for writ of certiorari to the Circuit Court of Appeals for the Ninth Circuit is granted limited to the first question presented by the petition for the writ.
